summary: RechargeMate is a mobile application designed to simplify the process of recharging prepaid mobile accounts by integrating multiple payment gateways and offering a wide range of recharge options. The app aims to provide a seamless, secure, and user-friendly experience for users to top-up their mobile credits across various telecom operators.

user_stories.title: User Registration via Mobile Number
user_stories.i_want_to: register using my mobile number and authenticate via OTP
user_stories.so_that: I can securely access the app and manage my account
acceptance_criteria: Given a new user, when they open the app, then they should see an option to register using their mobile number.
Given a user enters their mobile number, when they request an OTP, then the system should send an OTP to the provided number.
Given a user receives an OTP, when they enter it correctly, then they should be successfully registered and logged into the app.

user_stories.title: Social Media Login
user_stories.i_want_to: log in using my Google or Facebook account
user_stories.so_that: I can quickly access the app without creating a new account
acceptance_criteria: Given a user, when they choose to log in with Google, then they should be redirected to Google's authentication page.
Given a user, when they choose to log in with Facebook, then they should be redirected to Facebook's authentication page.
Given a user successfully authenticates via Google or Facebook, then they should be logged into the app.

user_stories.title: Recharge Mobile Number
user_stories.i_want_to: recharge my mobile number by selecting my telecom operator and choosing a recharge amount
user_stories.so_that: I can top-up my mobile credits easily
acceptance_criteria: Given a user, when they select a telecom operator, then they should see available recharge plans and offers.
Given a user selects a recharge plan, when they confirm the transaction, then the system should process the recharge and update the user's balance.
Given a successful recharge, when the transaction is complete, then the user should receive a confirmation message.

user_stories.title: Integrate Multiple Payment Gateways
user_stories.i_want_to: use different payment gateways to complete my recharge transactions
user_stories.so_that: I have flexibility in choosing my payment method
acceptance_criteria: Given a user, when they proceed to payment, then they should see options for multiple payment gateways (e.g., PayPal, Stripe).
Given a user selects a payment gateway, when they enter their payment details, then the system should process the payment securely.
Given a user, when they opt to save their payment details, then the system should securely store the information for future use.

user_stories.title: View Transaction History
user_stories.so_that: I can keep track of my spending and recharge history
acceptance_criteria: Given a user, when they navigate to the transaction history section, then they should see a list of past transactions with details such as date, amount, and status.
Given a user, when they select a transaction, then they should see detailed information about that transaction.

user_stories.title: Support Multiple Languages
user_stories.i_want_to: use the app in my preferred language
user_stories.so_that: I can understand and navigate the app easily
acceptance_criteria: Given a user, when they open the app for the first time, then they should be prompted to select a language from English, Spanish, or Mandarin.
Given a user selects a language, when they navigate through the app, then all text should be displayed in the selected language.

user_stories.title: Receive Push Notifications
user_stories.i_want_to: receive notifications for successful recharges, failed transactions, and promotional offers
user_stories.so_that: I am informed about my transactions and offers
acceptance_criteria: Given a successful recharge, when the transaction is complete, then the user should receive a push notification confirming the recharge.
Given a failed transaction, when the system detects the failure, then the user should receive a push notification with details of the failure.
Given a promotional offer, when it is available, then the user should receive a push notification about the offer.
